questions.question: You fit only observations at time zero and every rate gives zero loss. What is the problem?
options: The batch is too small for a TPU.
The step size is too accurate.
The observations contain no information about the cooling rate.
questions.explanation: The initial state is independent of rate. No optimizer can recover a rate from data whose predictions do not depend on it.
optionFeedback: A larger accelerator batch repeats the same uninformative time-zero observations. Add measurements that depend on the unknown rate.
A smaller integration step cannot make a time-zero observation informative about dynamics. Inspect parameter sensitivity of the data.
The initial state is independent of rate. No optimizer can recover a rate from data whose predictions do not depend on it.
